name: Geode
description: A geode split open: bands of rind round a crystal-lined cavity.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 2%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, #000 0.00% 16.67%, transparent 16.67% 33.33%, #000 33.33% 50.00%, transparent 50.00% 66.67%, #000 66.67% 83.33%, transparent 83.33% 100.00%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, #000 0.00% 16.67%, transparent 16.67% 33.33%, #000 33.33% 50.00%, transparent 50.00% 66.67%, #000 66.67% 83.33%, transparent 83.33% 100.00%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 34%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(50.0% 0.0%, 57.9% 28.4%, 82.1% 11.7%, 69.9% 38.5%, 99.2% 41.3%, 72.7% 54.0%, 93.3% 75.0%, 64.8% 67.6%, 67.1% 97.0%, 50.0% 73.0%, 32.9% 97.0%, 35.2% 67.6%, 6.7% 75.0%, 27.3% 54.0%, 0.8% 41.3%, 30.1% 38.5%, 17.9% 11.7%, 42.1% 28.4%); clip-path: polygon(50.0% 0.0%, 57.9% 28.4%, 82.1% 11.7%, 69.9% 38.5%, 99.2% 41.3%, 72.7% 54.0%, 93.3% 75.0%, 64.8% 67.6%, 67.1% 97.0%, 50.0% 73.0%, 32.9% 97.0%, 35.2% 67.6%, 6.7% 75.0%, 27.3% 54.0%, 0.8% 41.3%, 30.1% 38.5%, 17.9% 11.7%, 42.1% 28.4%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
